GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away well. Pushed fwd & shared lead Four Wide No Cover early . Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken =lead Five Wide on home turn. Pressured & challenged leader @ 250m. Fought on in 2-horse battle in last 200m. Shaded late. # Worked/tried hard.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very wide and without cover throughout the event. Was contacted slightly just prior to the finish.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 1 length clear, ridden along turn, joined Straightening Up , drew 1 length clear 100m, kept on strong, headed late # led 1 length 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover in the early stages before being allowed to stride forward to the lead position near the 600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Rolled fwd & raced 4th on inside (2L from lead) early . Tracked leaders Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 200m & chased well in last 100m but just fell short. # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up rounding the home turn near the 400m. Raced greenly when placed under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd fence 2 lengths. got around leaders turn 1 length. weakened. Every Chance # Ordinary Effort
